{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool crepe trousers, straight cut, full length to the shoe, charcoal #3A3D42, lined wool blend

Merino turtleneck sweater, fitted refined knit, hip length, ivory #EDE6D6, fine-gauge merino

Textured wool-blend jacket, tailored single-breasted blazer cut, hip length, dark grey herringbone #4A4D52, wool with a soft brushed finish

Long puffer-style wool coat, straight cut, knee-to-mid-calf length, deep navy #1F2A44, heavy wool with a water-repellent finish and a warm lining

Ankle boots, low block heel, waterproof leather with a grippy rubber lug sole, black #1A1A1A, sealed leather that wipes clean of road salt

Thermal tights under the trousers, ankle length, black #141414, soft stretch merino blend

Knit beanie, snug, covers the ears, charcoal #3A3D42, merino wool

Scarf, wide and long, wrapped twice at the neck, burgundy #6B1F2E, soft wool

Lined gloves, wrist length, black #1A1A1A, leather with a fleece lining

Tote bag, structured, fits a laptop and zips closed, black #1A1A1A, water-resistant coated canvas

Why this outfit works: It reads as neat business dress, with the turtleneck, tailored jacket and trousers giving a polished office look, while the thermal tights, long coat, hat, scarf and gloves keep you warm through a 20-minute walk in deep frost. The waterproof lug-sole boots grip snowy pavement and shrug off road salt, and the trousers sit clear of the slush at full length. The calm palette of charcoal, grey, ivory and navy lets the burgundy scarf add a single touch of colour. At the office you can simply take off the coat, hat, scarf and gloves and be fully dressed for work."}
